Middle module: green PCB, white label with 'ProMOS' branding, 512MB 1Rx8 DDR2-533MHz-CL4, PC2-4200U-444-10-A0, Assembly in Malaysia.

claims.evidence: All three main modules in photos 0, 1, and 2 are 512MB DDR2 desktop RAM, with visible labels confirming capacity and type. The modules appear physically clean and undamaged.

risks.risk: RAM may not work or may be faulty
risks.proof: A video showing the modules being tested in a compatible desktop motherboard with POST and memory diagnostics (e.g., MemTest86).

risks.risk: Modules may be mismatched or incompatible in a multi-module setup
risks.proof: A photo showing all three modules side-by-side with their full labels and a photo of the motherboard's RAM slots to confirm compatibility.
risks.if_unproven: priced as single-module use only, with no guarantee of compatibility

risks.risk: Modules may have latent physical damage or corrosion not visible in photos
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the gold contacts under magnification or a video showing the modules being gently bent to check for cracks.
risks.if_unproven: priced with assumption of physical integrity, but with lower value due to unverified condition

response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as three 512MB DDR2 desktop RAM modules from different brands (Pentium, ProMOS, Samsung), with visible labels confirming specifications.
